intro: Pozzik is an esteemed goblin tinkerer and racer stationed at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Once one of the most respected engineers in Undermine, he now dedicates his technical genius to constructing experimental rocket cars and settling the ultimate debate of engineering supremacy against his gnome counterpart.

p: Before retiring to the harsh salt flats of Thousand Needles, Pozzik built a legendary reputation among the goblins. As one of the most respected tinkerers out of Undermine, his technical expertise spans complex internal combustion, propulsion, and hazardous chassis construction. Rather than settling into comfortable obscurity, however, Pozzik took his mechanical mastery into the desert to push high-speed machinery far past its breaking point.

sections.t: The Duel on the Salt Flats
p: At the Mirage Raceway, Pozzik teamed up with his perennial gnome counterpart, Fizzle Brassbolts. Despite the historic rivalry between goblin explosives and delicate gnomish calibration, the two worked together to construct the sprawling racetrack across the dried lakebed. They field opposing racing outfits, testing prototype rocket cars to definitively prove whose racial design philosophy dominates the track. Naturally, Pozzik is always on the lookout for resourceful adventurers willing to acquire parts and shave weight off his designs.
